name: Ngrok
description: Official Ngrok tunnel agent (ngrok/ngrok:3.39.13-alpine) running as a single lightweight container with local web inspector on port 4040, required NGROK_AUTHTOKEN and NGROK_URL, and configurable NGROK_TARGET.
author: ngrok

form_fields.label: NGROK_AUTHTOKEN
form_fields.hint: Ngrok authentication token from your Ngrok dashboard.

form_fields.label: NGROK_URL
form_fields.hint: Static Ngrok domain or endpoint URL passed to --url (such as my-url.ngrok-free.dev).

form_fields.label: NGROK_TARGET
form_fields.hint: Target port or host:port forwarded by Ngrok (for example 80, 8080, runtipi-reverse-proxy:80, or container:3000). Leave blank to default to 80.

form_fields.label: container_name
form_fields.hint: Custom Docker container name. Default: ngrok (if left blank, falls back to ngrok).
form_fields.pattern_error: Must start with a letter or number and contain at least 2 characters (letters, numbers, '.', '_' or '-').
